title: Bali Island Retreat
coverAlt: Aerial view of green rice terraces in Bali

gallery.alt: Aerial view of green rice terraces in Bali

overview: Jungle, temples and ocean cliffs at an easy pace. Three nights in a pool villa in Ubud bring rice terraces, waterfalls and a spa day, then three nights by the beach in Seminyak end with sunset at Uluwatu temple.
